interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed engineering change agent for robots and embedded systems.
interface.longDescription: Discuss a hardware change in Codex, freeze the approved design, bind simulation and test evidence, and let the independent FORGE backend evaluate release readiness.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use FORGE to inspect my project context, discuss an evidence-backed change plan, ask before freezing a candidate or recording results, and let FORGE—not the language model—decide release readiness.
